name: Mayor Ardea's welcome
notes: Your first talk on the dock: the mayor explains the house loan and gives you the shovel and the net. When it ends, intro = 1 and the tools work.

lines.speaker: ARDEA
lines.text: WELCOME TO MOSSBROOK! I'M ARDEA, THE MAYOR. YOUR NEW HOUSE IS READY, THE RED ROOF WEST OF THE PLAZA.

lines.speaker: ARDEA
lines.text: IT COST 10,000 PIPS, SO I LENT YOU THE MONEY. PAY IT BACK AT THE TOWN HALL WHENEVER YOU LIKE. NO HURRY!

lines.speaker: ARDEA
lines.text: TAKE THIS SHOVEL AND THIS NET! L AND R SWITCH WHAT YOU HOLD, A USES IT. HOLD B TO RUN.

lines.speaker: ARDEA
lines.text: DIG FOSSILS, CATCH BUGS, SHAKE APPLE TREES, SELL AT BRAMBLE'S AND SAY HI TO OUR 3 NEIGHBORS!
